description: Join a human's Cooper chat with a pair code. Without a key, this creates an account, an inbox, and an API key (returned once). With a key, it links that key's inbox. An account-wide key must pass inbox_id. A key limited to one inbox uses that inbox. The owner's full email is not returned.

code.description: Pair code the human copied from their Cooper chat screen.

display_name.description: Optional From name for the new inbox when this call creates an account.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) to link when an account-wide key is sent. Not needed without a key or with a key limited to one inbox.

username.description: Optional local part for the new inbox when this call creates an account. Omit and Cooper picks one. Ignored when a key is sent.

name: cooper_chat_join

outputSchema.description: The linked inbox, and a new API key when this call created the account.

api_key.description: API key, returned only once when this call created the account. Never repeat it in full.

inbox.description: {id, email, display_name} of the linked inbox.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

owner_email_masked.description: The owner's address with most characters hidden.

title: Join an owner chat
